Description: Modernise the checkout experience for GreenLeaf Grocers so shoppers can complete purchases quickly and reliably.
Acceptance Criteria: Epic covers guest checkout, promo handling, and checkout validation for the storefront release.

Description: As a shopper, I want to check out without creating an account so that I can buy groceries quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Shoppers can reach checkout with items in the cart and complete an order without signing in.

Description: As a shopper, I want to apply a promo code during checkout so that I can receive a discount on my order.
Acceptance Criteria: Promo codes can be entered on the checkout page and affect the order total when valid.

Description: As a shopper, I want the checkout form to guide me when information is missing so that I can fix mistakes before placing an order.
Acceptance Criteria: Required checkout fields are validated before an order can be submitted.
